description: Telangana IT Minister D Sridhar Babu addressed DevFest 2026 virtually, where organisers showcased an AI-based avatar of the minister as part of a gathering of more than 3,300 developers, students and technology professionals in Hyderabad.
body_lead: Telangana Information Technology Minister D Sridhar Babu on Saturday addressed the DevFest 2026 gathering virtually with a keynote titled “Innovation at Scale” at the event organised by Google Developer Group (GDG) Hyderabad. “As Telangana works towards becoming a global AI hub, we want our young innovators to be at the centre of that journey,” Sridhar Babu said.
